from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = next(c for c in counts if c != background)
    return [[foreground if cell == background else 0 for cell in row] for row in grid]
